title: AutoMARS: Automatic and Scalable Multi-Agent Large Language Model Framework for Supply Chain Risk Assessment
abstract: arXiv:2610.17206v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose AutoMARS (Automatic Multi-Agent Risk Assessment), an agentic framework for automatic and scalable comparative risk assessment in supply chain networks. The framework enables end-to-end execution of analytical workflows by automatically planning tasks, coordinating specialized agents, invoking external analytical tools, and synthesizing domain-specific results into integrated risk evaluations. AutoMARS further supports scalable risk comparison across multiple locations by parallelizing independent analytical tasks. The framework adopts a multi-domain, multi-agent, and multi-tool architecture that integrates heterogeneous risk factors from socioeconomic, disaster, environmental, and transportation domains. Through coordinated agent interactions and tool integration, AutoMARS enables structured, systematic, and interpretable comparative analysis to support supply chain risk-aware location evaluation.

translated_title: AutoMARS：面向供应链风险评估的自动化、可扩展多智能体大语言模型框架
translated_abstract: 我们提出了AutoMARS（自动化多智能体风险评估），这是一个用于供应链网络中自动化、可扩展的比较风险评估的智能体框架。该框架通过自动规划任务、协调专业化智能体、调用外部分析工具，并将特定领域的结果综合为集成的风险评估，实现分析工作流的端到端执行。AutoMARS还通过并行化独立的分析任务，支持跨多个地点的可扩展风险比较。该框架采用多领域、多智能体、多工具的架构，整合来自社会经济、灾害、环境和交通领域的异构风险因素。通过协调的智能体交互和工具集成，AutoMARS能够进行结构化、系统化且可解释的比较分析，以支持供应链风险感知的选址评估。
tldr: AutoMARS是一个自动化、可扩展的多智能体大语言模型框架，通过协调专业智能体与外部工具，整合社会经济、灾害、环境和交通等多领域风险因素，实现供应链网络中结构化、可解释的跨地点比较风险评估。
en_tdlr: AutoMARS is an automatic and scalable multi-agent LLM framework that coordinates specialized agents and external tools to integrate heterogeneous risk factors from socioeconomic, disaster, environmental, and transportation domains, enabling structured, systematic, and interpretable comparative risk assessment across supply chain locations.
